image_description: A Dungeness crab (Cancer magister) positioned centrally on a bed of smooth, multi-colored river stones. The crab displays a broad, oval carapace with purplish-brown coloration and lighter mottling. Its robust claws are visible at the front, and walking legs extend laterally, blending somewhat with the rocky background.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The distal segments of the walking legs lack clear boundaries against the rocks, appearing to melt into or fuse with the background stones, a common AI generation error in complex textures.
The mottled pattern on the shell lacks the micro-texture of real calcified exoskeleton, appearing slightly painted or overly smooth in patches.
The articulation points of the legs on the right side appear anatomically vague, lacking distinct joint segments.
